name: All-Hands Meeting
description: All-hands or company-wide meeting template covering announcements, team updates, and Q&A.

sections.title: Announcements
sections.instruction: Summarize the key announcements shared during the meeting, including company news, policy changes, and strategic updates.

sections.title: Team Updates
sections.instruction: List updates from each team or department presented during the meeting.

sections.title: Q&A Highlights
sections.instruction: List the most notable questions asked and the answers or responses provided.

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: List all assigned tasks with their owners and due date. Always add reference transcript segment and timestamp in the table.
sections.item_format:
| **Owner** | Task | Due | Reference Transcript Segment | Segment Time stamp |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
